shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Floating tab bar over video and cards (Android elevation 14).

shadows.name: ledge
shadows.purpose: Hard ledge under tactile controls; the face drops into it on press.

motion.name: spring-bouncy
motion.purpose: Celebratory pops, press release, nav flourishes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one ember call to action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 56px; padding: 0 32px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: #FF5A3C; color: #0A0A0F; font: 700 17px Figtree, sans-serif; transition: transform .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.95); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F4F3EF; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet text button under the primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; background: none; color: #B3B2BD; font: 600 15px Figtree, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { color: #F4F3EF; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F4F3EF; border-radius: 12px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Chunky tactile chip with a hard ledge it presses into.
components.css: .ds-chip { height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 16px; border: 2px solid #2A2A35; background: #14141B; color: #F4F3EF; font: 700 15px Figtree, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #2A2A35; transition: transform .08s, box-shadow .08s; } .ds-chip:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 #2A2A35; } .ds-chip-on { background: #4FE3B0; border-color: #318D6D; color: #0A0A0F; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #318D6D; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F4F3EF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Tonal container on the ink ground.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #14141B; border-radius: 20px; padding: 16px; } .ds-card-t { color: #8C8B97; font: 500 13px Figtree, sans-serif; } .ds-card-n { color: #F4F3EF; font: 500 28px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; margin: 4px 0 12px; } .ds-card-n span { color: #8C8B97; font-size: 15px; } .ds-card-bar { height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: #1D1D26; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-bar i { display: block; width: 53%; height: 100%; background: #FF5A3C; }

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: Floating capsule; the active pill takes the tab's colour.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; height: 64px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(20,20,27,.94); border: 1px solid #2A2A35; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.45); align-items: center; } .ds-tab { flex: 1; display: flex; justify-content: center; } .ds-on { background: #FF5A3C; border-radius: 16px; height: 42px; max-width: 54px; margin: 0 auto; align-items: center; } .ds-tab:not(.ds-on):hover svg * { stroke: #F4F3EF; }

components.name: Icon Circle
components.description: Filled lane-colour circle with an ink icon (inbox categories).
components.html: ★♥✉
components.css: .ds-ic { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #0A0A0F; font: 700 20px Figtree, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
Payhas is a dark, calm room. The ground is near-black ink, the surfaces are a step or two lighter, and nothing glows unless it means something. The glow comes from two places only: one warm ember for "do this", and the four lane colours, which tell you who and how old. A parent picks the phone up at night and it feels quiet and trustworthy. A child touches it and it comes alive.

That second half is the component doctrine: quiet chrome, loud touch. At rest the interface nearly disappears. Feed chrome is small text over video, the tab bar is a dim floating capsule, and the icons are outlines. Under a finger, everything answers. Chips press down into a hard ledge, tiles dip and spring back, the active tab's pill jelly-slides to its new home, and each nav icon does its own little move. Expression lives in the response, not in the resting state.

Illustration is hand-made. Topic stickers, nav icons and animal avatars are drawn for Payhas with a bold ink outline, a fill in the tile or lane colour and white highlights. They are never pulled from a stock icon set. The world is never light-mode and never pastel. Colour arrives saturated, against the dark.
keyCharacteristics: Dark ink ground with tonal surfaces. Colour is rare and always means something.
One action colour (ember), always with ink text on it.
Four lane colours as identity, never decoration.
Quiet at rest, playful under touch. Spring physics, not timed easing.
Hand-drawn stickers and icons with an ink outline, colour fill and white glint.
Rounded, soft, chunky geometry. Nothing sharp.

rules.name: The One Ember Rule
rules.body: Ember is the only action colour, and a screen has at most one ember call to action. Text on ember is ink.

rules.name: The Lanes Mean Age Rule
rules.body: Lane colours identify an age lane or a profile. Never use one as a generic accent where it could be read as the wrong lane.

rules.name: The Night-Only Rule
rules.body: There is no light theme. Surfaces step up from ink in tone. They never go pale or pastel.

rules.name: The Tight Headline Rule
rules.body: Bricolage always runs with negative tracking (−0.3 to −1px, scaling with size). Figtree never gets negative tracking.

rules.name: The Four-Language Rule
rules.body: Every text box must fit the longest of Turkmen, Russian, Turkish and English. Size layouts for the longest string, not the English one.

rules.name: The Ledge, Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Tactile controls show depth with a hard offset ledge they press into, never a blurred drop shadow. Blurred shadows are reserved for things that float over content.

dos: Do keep ink (#0A0A0F) as the ground of every screen and build depth with surface tones.
Do put ink text on every coloured fill, whether ember or lane.
Do draw new icons and illustrations as Payhas stickers: an ink outline, a colour fill and a white glint, with round caps.
Do give every touchable element a spring response: press dip, ledge drop or flourish.
Do use the motion presets and the <Enter> stagger instead of inventing timings.
Do run Bricolage headings with negative tracking, and put numbers in JetBrains Mono.
donts: Don't use generic stock icon sets (Lucide or Material line icons) where a hand-made Payhas icon belongs.
Don't introduce a light theme, pale surfaces, or the pastel candy look typical of children's apps.
Don't use more than one ember call to action on a screen, or use ember for decoration.
Don't use a lane colour where it could be mistaken for a different lane.
Don't give tactile controls blurred drop shadows. Use the ledge.
Don't let chrome compete with video. Feed overlays stay small and quiet until touched.
